look_here_first: Start at the perennial basal rosette and nearly leafless flowering scapes. Because local T. scaposa can look very similar, confirm the taxonomic concept and provenance instead of identifying a scaped yellow daisy as acaulis by color.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Leaves concentrated at the base; flowering stalks mostly leafless.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: One yellow radiate head per scape.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Reviewed var. acaulis is Panhandle/Great Plains-centered; identity must not be inferred from a generic Central Texas four-nerve daisy.
